structure M64FamilyAnnulusNet (G : M63AmbientGeometry F)
    (Gamma : ContinuousMap LoopTwoSphere (C1FreeLoopSpace (M := M)))
    (mu : ℝ) where
  node_count : ℕ
  nodes : Fin node_count → LoopTwoSphere
  circumference_cutoff : ℝ
  cutoff_positive : 0 < circumference_cutoff
  covers : ∀ z : LoopTwoSphere, ∃ i : Fin node_count,
    ∀ circumference (h : 0 < circumference), circumference < circumference_cutoff →
      ∃ A : M64Annulus ((G.product circumference h).flow.metric a)
        (m63CanonicalRamp (G.product circumference h) (periodicFreeLoop (Gamma z)))
        (m63CanonicalRamp (G.product circumference h)
          (periodicFreeLoop (Gamma (nodes i)))), A.area < mu

theorem m64FamilyAnnulusNets_of_compact
    {M : Type u} [TopologicalSpace M] [T2Space M]
    [ChartedSpace LoopAmbient M] [IsManifold (𝓡 3) ∞ M]
    {a b : ℝ} {F : RicciFlow 3 M (Icc a b)}
    (G : M63AmbientGeometry F) (hcompact : IsCompact (univ : Set M)) :
    M64FamilyAnnulusNets G := by
  intro Gamma mu hmu
  let e : Metric.sphere (0 : LoopAmbient) 1 ≃ₜ LoopTwoSphere :=
    Homeomorph.setCongr (by ext z; exact mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm)
  let : CompactSpace LoopTwoSphere := e.compactSpace
  obtain ⟨epsilon, hepsilon, hannuli⟩ :=
    m64_uniform_close_loop_canonical_annuli F a hcompact Gamma Gamma.continuous hmu
  obtain ⟨k, nodes, hnodes⟩ :=
    m64_finite_loop_value_net (F.metric a) Gamma Gamma.continuous hepsilon
  refine ⟨{
    node_count := k
    nodes := nodes
    circumference_cutoff := curvePeriod
    cutoff_positive := Real.two_pi_pos
    covers := ?_ }⟩
  intro z
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hnodes z
  exact ⟨i, fun circumference h hc =>
    hannuli z (nodes i) hi circumference (G.product circumference h) hc.le⟩

tex_content.label: lem:annular-finite-net
tex_content.html:
Lemma
[A finite annular net uniform in circumference] ↗ def:annular-geodesic

Let $\Gamma :S^2\to \Lambda ^1M$ be continuous and let $\mu >0$. There are finitely many $z_1,\ldots ,z_m\in S^2$ and $\rho _*>0$ such that every $z$ has one selected $z_i$ for which, for every $0<\rho <\rho _*$, an actual initial annulus joins their canonical ramps and has area less than $\mu $. The node is selected before $\rho $ and works at all smaller circumferences. Nullity is not required. Source: MT20071. pp. 461–462
Proof

The compact family has a uniform angular derivative bound. The minimizing interpolator has a uniform endpoint differential bound $B$ near the diagonal. For uniformly $\epsilon $-close loops, its canonical lift has column bounds $B+1,\epsilon $ for all $0<\rho \leq 2\pi $, hence area at most $2\pi (B+1)\epsilon $. Choose $\epsilon $ to make this less than $\mu $ and then take a finite cover of the compact family by uniform $\epsilon $-balls. The same center and interpolator work for every smaller circumference.

□
